# NXTutors

> NXTutors is an Indian home and online tutoring service that matches students with ID-verified private tutors for CBSE, ICSE, ISC, IB and IGCSE boards, and for JEE, NEET and SAT exam preparation. Instead of returning a long directory to sift through, the platform takes a subject and a locality and proposes two or three specific tutor matches, each offered with a free demo class.

NXTutors operates across 24 Indian cities, with the densest coverage in Gurugram and Delhi NCR. Tutoring is delivered both at home and online. Published typical pricing is ₹800–2,500 per hour, varying by board, class level and subject; the company states it has matched 4,500+ families. A demo class is free and requires no card or commitment.

Operated by NXTUTORS EDTECH PVT LTD, BLK-2/49, M3M Cosmopolitan, off Golf Course Extension Road, Sector 66, Gurugram, Haryana 122101, India. Contact: support@nxtutors.com, +91 78360 34313.

## Board and subject courses

- [ISC Maths, Classes 11–12](https://www.nxtutors.com/course/class-11-12-isc-mathematics): ISC mathematics tutoring and exam preparation for the senior secondary years.
- [IGCSE Extended Maths](https://www.nxtutors.com/course/igcse-extended-mathematics): Tutoring and exam preparation for the IGCSE Extended mathematics tier.
- [IB DP Maths AA (SL & HL)](https://www.nxtutors.com/course/ib-dp-mathematics-analysis-approaches-sl-hl): IB Diploma Analysis and Approaches at Standard and Higher Level.
